title: Agent Overlap: Owners & Site Fixes

optionA.desc: Portfolio keeps the numbers and Miles reads them when it needs points data.

optionA.desc: The receiver posts one line in the team feed: got it, done or when.

pairs.ask: Security Fix For smartupkeep.ai: Security Hands It To UpKeep Or Grok Bot Does?

optionA.desc: Security writes the fix request and UpKeep makes the change on its own site.

pairs.ask: Editing A Locked Page: Each Agent Unlocks Its Own Or Security Does It?

optionA.label: Each Agent
optionA.desc: Agents run unlock, edit, relock and push themselves, following the page-lock rule.
